title: Canonical source projections for generated execution profiles

path.description: Relative POSIX path under loom/data; absolute paths, empty/dot/parent segments, backslashes and filesystem symlink escapes are rejected by the generator.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer. Empty string addresses the whole document. Array indexes must be canonical nonnegative decimals.

output.description: Unique runtime/<domain>.pack output. Generated outputs cannot be source inputs or symlinks.

definition.description: Descriptor template with declared slots. The resolved descriptor must satisfy loom.runtime_profile/1 and its value schema.

target.description: Existing template slot to replace, or empty for the whole definition. Overlapping projection targets are rejected.
